units.source_text: 这并非他故意做作，却是那露水自然地停留在他所持的花上，并不滴落。

en.t: This was not something he had deliberately contrived; the dew had simply settled naturally on the flower he was holding and did not fall.

units.source_text: 二女公子看了觉得很有意趣。

en.t: The Second Princess saw it and found it very charming.

units.source_text: 那花是带着露水而枯萎的。

en.t: The flower had withered while still bearing the dew.
